add-foreign-key: Both MinHash tables are new and empty, so their foreign keys validate no existing rows. Each foreign key takes a SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock on the referenced entity_versions, entities, workspaces or organization table. The 1s lock_timeout bounds the wait to acquire each lock and the 5s statement_timeout bounds each statement, but neither bounds how long an acquired lock is held: every lock is kept until the migration transaction commits, blocking writes to those tables for the rest of this short, catalog-only migration.
row-level-security: Row security is enabled and forced on the two new empty tables before application code can write them.
create-policy: Policies are catalog-only additions to the two new empty tables and run under the migration's one-second lock timeout.
